command: erl -noshell -eval 'Release = erlang:system_info(otp_release), {ok, Version} = file:read_file(filename:join([code:root_dir(), "releases", Release, "OTP_VERSION"])), io:format("OTP ~s~n", [string:trim(Version)]), lists:foreach(fun(B) -> try V = json:decode(B), io:format("~s accepted ~p~n", [B,V]) catch C:R -> io:format("~s rejected ~p:~p~n", [B,C,R]) end end, [<<"1e-400">>, <<"1e400">>, <<"0e999999">>]), halt().'
